name: Routines
source:
Five years under MASK, and now your hands know exactly what to do. Apply, remove, discard – the mask takes the pain. You’ve mastered your work.

[From [url=https://frigidbody.itch.io/routines]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
戴口罩五年了，现在你的双手清楚地知道该怎么做。敷上、取下、丢弃——面膜可以减轻疼痛。你已经掌握了你的工作。

[来自[url=https://frigidbody.itch.io/routines]Itch.io[/url]]
